prompt: In right triangle $ABC$ the right angle is at $C$. The side opposite $\angle A$ is $3$ and the hypotenuse is $5$. What is $\sin A$? Give a decimal.

hints.text: Opposite $\angle A$ is $3$; the hypotenuse is $5$. Divide.

explanation: Sine of an angle is the opposite side divided by the hypotenuse.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why it is always less than 1
steps: The hypotenuse is the longest side of a right triangle, so the opposite side is always smaller.
A smaller number over a bigger one is less than $1$ — if your sine ever comes out above $1$, you flipped the fraction.
